mapper.sql: m.device_code, m.device_status, m.province_code, m.city_code, m.county_code, m.town_code, m.location, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.area_code, m.adm_code, m.manufacturer_code, m.model_code, m.site_code, m.is_cascade, m.collect_type, m.creator, m.create_time, m.modifier, m.update_time
mapper.select:
select * from ( select distinct ,
CAST(ST_DISTANCE(POINT(#{userLongitude},#{userLatitude}),POINT(m.longitude,m.latitude))*111195 as DECIMAL(65,2)) as distance,
pro.area_name as provinceName, city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName, town.area_name as townName, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else rel.device_name end ) device_name, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '0' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '2' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '1' END) orderStatus, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '有效' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '退订' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '失效' END) orderStatusName from vm_recorder_device_info_t m join vm_order_recorder_devices od on od.device_code = m.device_code left join vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = m.device_code and rel.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = od.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = '3' left JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = m.device_code and dct.coll_obj_type = '12' AND dct.user_id = #{userId} left join sys_area pro ON pro.area_code = m.province_code left join sys_area city ON city.area_code = m.city_code left join sys_area county ON county.area_code = m.county_code left join sys_area town ON town.area_code = m.town_code
LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t vod on vod.device_code = m.device_code and vod.delete_flag = '0' and vod.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and vod.device_type = '13'
and dct.user_device_coll_id IS NOT NULL
and m.device_code in
#{item}
${dataScope}
ORDER BY field(od.ord_status,1,0,2,4,3) ASC ) recorder
1 = 1
and recorder.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
and recorder.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{codeOrName}, '%') or recorder.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{codeOrName}, '%')
order by recorder.distance,recorder.device_status,cast(recorder.device_code as UNSIGNED),recorder.device_code
order by recorder.device_status,cast(recorder.device_code as UNSIGNED),recorder.device_code
order by recorder.province_code, recorder.city_code, recorder.county_code,recorder.device_code

select * from (select distinct m.device_code, m.device_status, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else rel.device_name end ) device_name, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.province_code, m.city_code, m.county_code, m.town_code, pro.area_name as provinceName, city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName, town.area_name as townName, '1' as prolevel, '2' as citylevel, '3' as countrylevel, m.device_code as code, m.device_name as name, '4' as townLevel, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else rel.device_name end ) device_alias FROM vm_recorder_device_info_t m INNER JOIN vm_order_recorder_devices od ON od.device_code = m.device_code LEFT JOIN sys_area pro ON pro.area_code = m.province_code LEFT JOIN sys_area city ON city.area_code = m.city_code LEFT JOIN sys_area county ON county.area_code = m.county_code LEFT JOIN sys_area town ON town.area_code = m.town_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = m.device_code and rel.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = od.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = '3'
LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t vod on vod.device_code = m.device_code and vod.delete_flag = '0' and vod.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and vod.device_type = '13'
and od.ord_status in (0,1,2) ${dataScope} GROUP BY od.tenant_id, od.industry_code, od.device_code
) recorder
recorder.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
order by recorder.province_code, recorder.city_code, recorder.county_code, recorder.town_code, recorder.device_code
mapper.insert: insert into vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t( device_code, device_name, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code, device_type, delete_flag, creator, create_time, modifier, update_time ) values (#{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{tenantId}, #{industryCode}, #{appVerCode}, #{deviceType}, '0', #{creator}, now(), #{modifier}, now() )
mapper.select:
select distinct , pro.area_name as provinceName, city.area_name as cityName, county.area_name as countyName, town.area_name as townName, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then m.device_name else rel.device_name end ) device_name, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '0' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '2' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '1' END) orderStatus, (CASE WHEN od.ord_status in ('0','1','2') THEN '有效' WHEN od.ord_status = '3' THEN '退订' WHEN od.ord_status = '4' THEN '失效' END) orderStatusName, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor, (select DICT_LABEL FROM sys_dict_data where DICT_TYPE = 'recorder_device_mfgr_code' and status = '0' AND DICT_VALUE = m.manufacturer_code limit 1) manufacturerName, ch.channel_code, ch.device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(chaAls.channel_name, '')) = 0 then ch.channel_name else chaAls.channel_name end ) channel_name, ch.channel_status from vm_recorder_device_info_t m join vm_order_recorder_devices od on od.device_code = m.device_code left join vm_recorder_channel_info_t ch on m.device_code = ch.device_code and ch.delete_flag = 0 left join vm_tenant_device_channel_common_rel_t chaAls on chaAls.channel_code = ch.channel_code and chaAls.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and chaAls.industry_code = od.industry_code and chaAls.delete_flag = 0 and chaAls.device_type = 1 left JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = m.device_code and dct.coll_obj_type = '12' AND dct.user_id = #{userId} left join vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = m.device_code and rel.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = od.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = 0 and rel.device_type = 3 left join sys_area pro ON pro.area_code = m.province_code left join sys_area city ON city.area_code = m.city_code left join sys_area county ON county.area_code = m.county_code left join sys_area town ON town.area_code = m.town_code
m.delete_flag = 0 and od.delete_flag = 0 and od.ord_status in ('0', '1', '2') and m.device_code = #{deviceCode} ${dataScope}

select channel.channel_code, channel.device_code as parent_device_code, channel.channel_status as status from vm_recorder_channel_info_t channel where channel.delete_flag = '0' and channel.device_code in
#{item}

select channel.channel_code, channel.device_code as parent_device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(chaAls.channel_name, '')) = 0 then channel.channel_name else chaAls.channel_name end ) channel_name, channel.channel_status as status from vm_recorder_channel_info_t channel left join vm_tenant_device_channel_common_rel_t chaAls on chaAls.channel_code = channel.channel_code and chaAls.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and chaAls.industry_code = #{industryCode} and chaAls.delete_flag = 0 and chaAls.device_type = 1 where channel.delete_flag = '0' and channel.device_code in
#{item}

SELECT DISTINCT gg.dept_id as org_id, gg.dept_name as org_name, gg.dept_level as org_level, gg.parent_id as parent_org_id, dd.device_code, IFNULL(rel.device_name, de.device_name) AS device_name, cc.channel_code, concat(gg.dept_level + 1) AS devLevel, (case when length(IFNULL(chaAls.channel_name, '')) = 0 then cc.channel_name else chaAls.channel_name end ) channel_name, cc.channel_status as status, 'false' AS checked, de.longitude, de.latitude, 1 AS num, de.site_code,de.device_status, IF(cc.channel_status = '0', 1, 0) AS onlineNum, concat(gg.dept_level + 2) AS chanLevel, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor FROM sys_dept gg LEFT JOIN vm_organ_device_rel_t dd ON gg.dept_id = dd.dept_id and dd.device_type = 13 and gg.industry_code = dd.industry_code LEFT JOIN vm_recorder_device_info_t de ON dd.device_code = de.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_recorder_channel_info_t cc ON de.device_code = cc.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = cc.channel_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '13' and dct.user_id = #{param.userId} left join vm_order_recorder_devices vod on vod.industry_code = dd.industry_code and vod.device_code = de.device_code and vod.tenant_id = gg.tenant_id left join vm_tenant_device_channel_common_rel_t chaAls on chaAls.channel_code = cc.channel_code and chaAls.tenant_id = vod.tenant_id and chaAls.industry_code = vod.industry_code and chaAls.delete_flag = 0 and chaAls.device_type = 1 LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = vod.device_code and rel.tenant_id = vod.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = vod.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = 3 WHERE gg.del_flag = '0' AND dd.delete_flag = '0' AND de.delete_flag = '0' AND cc.delete_flag = '0' AND dd.device_code IS NOT NULL AND dd.device_code != '' AND vod.delete_flag = '0' AND vod.ord_status in (0,1,2)
and dct.user_device_coll_id IS NOT NULL
and cc.channel_status in
#{status}
${param.dataScope} ORDER BY gg.dept_id,dd.device_code, cc.channel_code

SELECT DISTINCT dataTable.device_code as deviceCode, dataTable.device_status, dataTable.device_name, ch.channel_code, (case when length(IFNULL(chaAls.channel_name, '')) = 0 then ch.channel_name else chaAls.channel_name end ) channel_name, ch.channel_status as status, dataTable.province_code as provinceId,pro.area_name as provinceName,dataTable.city_code as cityId, city.area_name as cityName,dataTable.county_code as countyId,county.area_name as countyName, dataTable.town_code as townCode, town.area_name as townName, dataTable.site_code, dataTable.longitude,dataTable.latitude, 'false' AS checked, '1' AS proLevel, '2' AS cityLevel,'3' AS countryLevel,'4' AS devLevel,'5' AS chanLevel, case when IFNULL(dct.user_device_coll_id,0) = 0 then '0' else '1' end isMonitor, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then dataTable.device_name else rel.device_name end ) deviceAlias FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.device_code, ord.tenant_id, m.site_code,ord.industry_code, ord.accept_node, m.device_name, m.province_code as province_code, m.city_code as city_code, m.town_code, m.county_code as county_code, ord.delete_flag, m.longitude, m.latitude, m.device_status FROM vm_order_recorder_devices ord LEFT JOIN vm_recorder_device_info_t m on m.device_code = ord.device_code where m.delete_flag= '0' and ord.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) and ord.delete_flag= '0' and ord.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and ord.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId} ) dataTable LEFT JOIN vm_recorder_channel_info_t ch on ch.device_code = dataTable.device_code left join vm_tenant_device_channel_common_rel_t chaAls on chaAls.channel_code = ch.channel_code and chaAls.tenant_id = #{param.tenantId} and chaAls.industry_code = #{param.industryCode} and chaAls.delete_flag = 0 and chaAls.device_type = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_area pro on pro.area_code = dataTable.province_code LEFT JOIN sys_area city on city.area_code = dataTable.city_code LEFT JOIN sys_area county on county.area_code = dataTable.county_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = dataTable.device_code and rel.tenant_id = dataTable.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = dataTable.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = 3 LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = ch.channel_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '13' AND dct.user_id = #{param.userId} LEFT JOIN sys_area town on town.area_code = dataTable.town_code WHERE ch.delete_flag = '0'
and dct.user_device_coll_id IS NOT NULL
and ch.channel_status in
#{status}
${param.dataScope} ORDER BY dataTable.province_code, dataTable.city_code, dataTable.county_code, dataTable.town_code, dataTable.device_code, ch.channel_code

select channel.channel_code, channel.device_code as parent_device_code, channel.channel_status as status from vm_recorder_channel_info_t channel where channel.delete_flag = '0' and channel.channel_code in
#{item}

select * from (select distinct recorder.device_code, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then recorder.device_name else rel.device_name end ) device_name, recorder.location, recorder.longitude, recorder.site_code, recorder.latitude, recorder.device_status from vm_recorder_device_info_t recorder INNER JOIN vm_order_recorder_devices od ON od.device_code = recorder.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = recorder.device_code and rel.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and rel.industry_code = od.industry_code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = 3 where recorder.delete_flag = '0' and od.delete_flag ='0' AND od.ord_status in (0, 1, 2)
and recorder.longitude like CONCAT('%', #{param.longitude}, '%')
and recorder.latitude like CONCAT('%', #{param.latitude}, '%')
${param.dataScope} GROUP BY od.tenant_id, od.industry_code, od.device_code order by recorder.province_code, recorder.city_code, recorder.county_code,recorder.device_code ) recorder_data
and ((recorder_data.device_code = #{param.keyWord}) or (recorder_data.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{param.keyWord}, '%')))
